head: b4f269983d97024d554934167379453ae0fc5407
claim: On a phone-sized browser page, Chief answers a message typed in his chat with a reply

runs.command: CHROME_DEVTOOLS_AXI_SESSION="${CHROME_DEVTOOLS_AXI_SESSION:?task-named session}" timeout -k 10 900 bash scripts/verify/phone-web-pair.sh "$DONE_DONE_EVIDENCE_ROOT" "${KEY_FILE:?authorized MiniMax key file}"

verdicts.seen: The newest message at the bottom of the thread is Chief's reply: "Good morning, Umer — ready when you are, Captain." It answers the user's typed message just above it, "Good morning Chief. Please say hello back in one short sentence." The footer reads "Done · 9 s", and the layout is phone-sized, so the screenshot shows the outcome.
